answer: Jury of 5, one seat per operator and per subnetwork. Duplicate submission forfeits the whole bond, no appeal. Idle keys lose 2 standing points per epoch. A farm of 300 keys on 3 hosts fills 3 seats, so 40% of its juries fail quorum and pay nothing. The knoll of cheap accounts is smaller than the reef it hides on, and the vine of referrals does not change the seat count.
